sql: SELECT TOP 20 p.SKU AS parentProductSku, ac.SKU AS addOnSku, ac.ProductName AS addOnName, gl.AddonGroupName AS addOnGroupName, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ap.DisplayOrder, ap.PimAddOnProductId, d.DisplayOrder, ac.SKU) AS addOnPosition FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.StoreCode = @store INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct ap ON ap.PimProductId = p.PimProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddonGroup g ON g.PimAddonGroupId = ap.PimAddonGroupId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddonGroupLocale gl ON gl.PimAddonGroupId = g.PimAddonGroupId AND gl.LocaleId = @localeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProductDetail d ON d.PimAddOnProductId = ap.PimAddOnProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct ac ON ac.PimProductId = d.PimChildProductId WHERE p.SKU = @parentSku AND p.ProductType = @productType AND p.IsActive = @isActive AND ac.IsActive = @isActive AND g.DisplayType = @addOnDisplayType AND EXISTS (SELECT xp.PriceId FROM dbo.ZnodePrice xp INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList xl ON xl.PriceListId = xp.PriceListId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal xo ON xo.PriceListId = xl.PriceListId WHERE xp.SKU = ac.SKU AND xo.PortalId = po.PortalId AND xp.RetailPrice > @zero AND ISNULL(xl.ActivationDate, @now) <= @now AND ISNULL(xl.ExpirationDate, @now) >= @now AND ISNULL(xp.ActivationDate, @now) <= @now AND ISNULL(xp.ExpirationDate, @now) >= @now) ORDER BY ap.DisplayOrder, ap.PimAddOnProductId, d.DisplayOrder, ac.SKU
